title: Vitamin C Protects Against Myocardial Damage Induced by Sepsis by Regulating the JAK2/STAT3 and NF-kappaB Signaling Pathways.
authors: Han, Rui-Dong; Tian, Na; Sun, Zi-Guo; Liu, An-Bu; Wang, Sheng; Shen, Yue; Liu, Jia; Feng, Ke; Yang, Li-Shan; Zhang, Jun-Fei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究维生素C对脓毒症心肌损伤的保护作用，仅用AutoDock Vina对VC与JAK2/STAT3/NF-kB蛋白做分子对接，核心是信号通路与心肌保护，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Previous studies have shown that vitamin C (VC) has a protective effect on sepsis-induced myocardial injury (SIMI); however, the mechanism of this effect remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of VC on SIMI in rats. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Sprague-Dawley rats were randomly divided into three groups: sham operation, cecum ligation and perforation (CLP), and VC groups. Cardiac function was assessed using the echocardiography and hematoxylin and eosin staining. Levels of serum inflammatory cytokines, superoxide dismutase, and malondialdehyde were measured via enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. AutoDock Vina was utilized for molecular docking to analyze the binding mechanism of VC with Janus kinase 2 (JAK2), signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3), and nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) protein. Protein expression of JAK2/STAT3 and NF-kappaB was assessed via Western blot, immunohistochemistry, or immunofluorescence staining. RESULTS: First, echocardiography and hematoxylin and eosin staining showed that VC alleviated SIMI in rats. Second, VC decreased interleukin (IL)-1beta, IL-6, tumor necrosis factor-alpha, and malondialdehyde levels but increased superoxide dismutase and IL-10 levels in CLP-induced SIMI as measured via enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. Third, VC reduced cardiomyocyte apoptosis in SIMI rats as shown by Western blot and immunohistochemistry staining, and decreased the expression of cleaved caspase-3 and Bax while increasing the expression of Bcl-2 in CLP-induced SIMI. Finally, molecular docking analysis indicated a strong and stable affinity of VC for JAK2/STAT3 and NF-kappaB signaling pathways. Western blot and immunofluorescence results showed that VC decreased the phosphorylation levels of JAK2, STAT3, NF-kappaB, and IkappaB kinasealpha/beta in SIMI rats. CONCLUSIONS: These results suggest that VC attenuates CLP-induced SIMI through its anti-inflammatory and antiapoptotic effects, mediated by regulation of the JAK2/STAT3 and NF-kappaB pathways.
abstract_zh: 引言：既往研究表明，维生素C（VC）对脓毒症诱导的心肌损伤（SIMI）具有保护作用；然而，其作用机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在评估VC对大鼠SIMI的影响。材料与方法：将Sprague-Dawley大鼠随机分为三组：假手术组、盲肠结扎穿孔（CLP）组和VC组。通过超声心动图和苏木精-伊红染色评估心脏功能。通过酶联免疫吸附测定法测量血清炎症细胞因子、超氧化物歧化酶和丙二醛水平。利用AutoDock Vina进行分子对接，分析VC与Janus激酶2（JAK2）、信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）和核因子kappa B（NF-kappaB）蛋白的结合机制。通过Western blot、免疫组织化学或免疫荧光染色评估JAK2/STAT3和NF-kappaB的蛋白表达。结果：首先，超声心动图和苏木精-伊红染色显示VC减轻了大鼠的SIMI。其次，通过酶联免疫吸附测定法测量，VC降低了CLP诱导的SIMI中白细胞介素（IL）-1beta、IL-6、肿瘤坏死因子-alpha和丙二醛水平，但增加了超氧化物歧化酶和IL-10水平。第三，Western blot和免疫组织化学染色显示，VC减少了SIMI大鼠的心肌细胞凋亡，并降低了cleaved caspase-3和Bax的表达，同时增加了Bcl-2的表达。最后，分子对接分析表明VC对JAK2/STAT3和NF-kappaB信号通路具有强且稳定的亲和力。Western blot和免疫荧光结果显示，VC降低了SIMI大鼠中JAK2、STAT3、NF-kappaB和IkappaB激酶alpha/beta的磷酸化水平。结论：这些结果表明，VC通过其抗炎和抗凋亡作用减轻CLP诱导的SIMI，这些作用由JAK2/STAT3和NF-kappaB通路的调节介导。
